records.context: Group-comparison functions delegate test selection to :mod:`spacr.figures.stats` while preserving this module's established call signatures and result keys. Two groups use Student's t, Welch's t, or Mann–Whitney U as supported by the data; larger designs use one-way ANOVA, Welch's ANOVA, or Kruskal–Wallis. Results identify the selected test and include the assumption checks used to select it.

records.source: Group-comparison functions delegate test selection to :mod:`spacr.figures.stats` while preserving this module's established call signatures and result keys. Two groups use Student's t, Welch's t, or Mann–Whitney U as supported by the data; larger designs use one-way ANOVA, Welch's ANOVA, or Kruskal–Wallis. Results identify the selected test and include the assumption checks used to select it.
records.translation: Hópsamanburðaraðgerðir úthluta prófvali til :mod:`spacr.figures.stats` á meðan þær varðveita staðfestar símtalaundirskriftir og niðurstöðulykla þessarar einingar. Tveir hópar nota Student's t, Welch's t, eða Mann–Whitney U eins og gögnin styðjast við; stærri hönnun notar einstefnu ANOVA, Welch's ANOVA eða Kruskal–Wallis. Niðurstöður bera kennsl á valið próf og innihalda forsendurprófanir sem notaðar eru til að velja það.
